band: band11 -- r=4 Reeve-dimension census, hunter 11/12: UNBOUNDED WEIGHT, TARGETED (maximise V/c over all shapes)
target: counterexample to the King-Tollu-Toumazet (2004) positivity conjecture: a triple (lam,mu,nu), |lam|+|mu|=|nu|, whose stretched LR polynomial P(n)=c(n nu; n lam, n mu) has a strictly negative coefficient
cell: r = 4  (hive polytope Q lives in R^3 = the Reeve dimension; deg P = dim Q <= 3)

result_headline.min_a1_attained_at: every unimodular hive simplex (h* = (1,0,0,0), V = 1, c = 4, P = C(n+3,3)); occurs at arbitrarily large weight, e.g. lam=(579,283,69), mu=(519,299,26), nu=(584,515,420,256), |nu| = 1775
result_headline.interpretation: V/c is NOT a discriminant: it rises monotonically to 6 along every ray in gap space while a1 grows linearly and stays positive. The scale-free discriminants are (i) the ratio V/(c+h3), which must exceed 3 and never did, and (ii) max V at c = 4 (empty lattice 3-polytope = the Reeve mechanism), which must reach 13 and was equal to 1 in EVERY region scanned -- every empty r=4 hive 3-polytope seen was unimodular, so no Reeve simplex T(p,q) with q >= 2 ever occurred.

exhaustive_regions.cube: all gap vectors in [0,12]^9  (13^9 = 10604499373 vectors; 1654867200 with Q nonempty)
exhaustive_regions.L1_ball: all gap vectors with g1+...+g9 <= 52  (C(61,9) = 17341763505 vectors; 801481767 with Q nonempty) -- reaches single gaps up to 52, i.e. shapes far outside any cube scanned before
exhaustive_regions.non_exhaustive_probes: uniform random gap vectors: 10^7 in [0,100]^9 and 10^6 in [0,300]^9 (thin chambers at very large weight)

moduli_reduction.claim: Q(lam,mu,nu) for r=4 depends on (lam,mu,nu) only through the 9 gaps a=(l1-l2,l2-l3,l3-l4), b=(m1-m2,m2-m3,m3-m4), c=(n1-n2,n2-n3,n3-n4), up to an INTEGER translation of R^3; hence L(n)=#(nQ cap Z^3), V, h*, P are functions of the gap vector alone. A gap vector is realisable by partitions iff D = Cw-Aw-Bw == 0 (mod 4), Aw = 3a3+2a2+a1 etc.
moduli_reduction.consequence: a gap-space census is a census at UNBOUNDED WEIGHT: one gap vector = infinitely many triples (lam,mu,nu) of arbitrarily large |nu|, all with the same P. The census is therefore exhaustive over ALL r=4 triples of EVERY weight whose consecutive-part gaps lie in the stated region.
moduli_reduction.verified_this_run: band11_xcheck.py: 1070 random gap vectors (gaps <= 9, 14, 20, 30), each lifted to two different partition triples: hive4.py gives identical L(1..3), V, h*, P for both lifts and identical values to band11_vcscan.exe -- 1070/1070 agreements, 0 failures

exact_identities_used.a1: 6 a1 = 11 + 2 h1 - h2 + 2 h3 = 3*c + 3*h3 - V   (h3 = # interior lattice points)
exact_identities_used.negativity_criterion: a1 < 0  <==>  V > 3*(c + h3). Hence V/c > 3 is NECESSARY, and when c = 4 (h*_1 = 0, an empty lattice 3-polytope such as a Reeve simplex T(p,q), V = q) it is exactly V >= 13
exact_identities_used.scaling: for integer t, Q(t*g) = t*Q(g), so a1(t*g) = t*a1(g) and V(t*g) = t^3 V(g): the SIGN of a1 is constant along each integer ray in gap space. Verified independently with hive4.py on 40 dim-3 directions at t = 2,3 (80/80 exact). Consequently V/c -> 6 and V/(c+h3) -> 3 from below along every ray, so both maxima are attained at the largest polytope of whatever region is scanned -- they are scale artifacts and are reported as such.

engines.polytope_engine_scanner: r4_reeve/band11_vcscan.cpp -> band11_vcscan.exe (cube scan; compiled before the --ray/--simplex modes were appended, eval kernel byte-identical) and band11_vcscan2.exe (current source, -DCBMAX=513, adds the --simplex L1-ball mode). Consistency: both binaries run on [0,8]^9 return identical record VALUES (only tie-breaking witnesses differ). Pure integer arithmetic; ratio records compared by cross-multiplication.
engines.independent_polytope_engine: r4_reeve/hive4.py (exact Fractions; vertices, volume by two independent routes, held-out interpolation checks at n=4,5)
engines.anchor_this_run: band11_lranchor.py (log anchor_records.txt): every record witness re-verified against BOTH LR engines on the stretched counts c(n nu; n lam, n mu). PASS at n=1..5 for the c=4 records and the V/c record of the S=40 ball (lam=(14,9,5), mu=(13,9,4), nu=(20,16,11,7): P(1..5) = 60,343,1031,2305,4346) and at n=1,2 for the V=3888 cube record (lam=mu=(36,24,12), nu=(54,42,30,18): 832, 5875). On the |nu|=1775 unimodular witness engine A agreed at n=1,2 while engine B returned CAP_EXCEEDED at n=2 (its DP-state budget, not a disagreement).

honesty: Absence of a counterexample proves nothing whatsoever about the King-Tollu-Toumazet conjecture and is never evidence for it. The two regions above are closed windows, nothing more; outside them the r=4 cell remains open.
